where.if:
AND (
PP.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_ID) LIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(#{keyword}), ',', ''), ' ', '') || '%'
OR TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY, 'FM9999999999999990') LIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(#{keyword}), ',', ''), ' ', '') || '%'
OR TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR TO_CHAR(PP.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR TO_CHAR(PP.DOC_SEQ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(#{keyword}), ',', ''), ' ', '') || '%'
OR I.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR I.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR I.ITEM_TYPE LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR I.ITEM_UNIT LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCTION_PLAN PP JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PLAN_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT PP.PROD_PLAN_ID, PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY, TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_PLAN_DATE, TO_CHAR(PP.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_DATE, TO_CHAR(PP.UPDATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATED_DATE, PP.REMARK, PP.ITEM_ID, TO_CHAR(PP.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DUE_DATE, PP.DOC_NO, PP.DOC_SEQ, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_UNIT FROM PRODUCTION_PLAN PP JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
ORDER BY PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE DESC, PP.PROD_PLAN_ID DESC ) PLAN_LIST WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE RN >= #{startRow}
SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_TYPE FROM ITEM WHERE ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ITEM_TYPE ASC

SELECT PP.PROD_PLAN_ID, PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY, TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_PLAN_DATE, TO_CHAR(PP.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_DATE, TO_CHAR(PP.UPDATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATED_DATE, PP.REMARK, PP.ITEM_ID, TO_CHAR(PP.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DUE_DATE, PP.DOC_NO, PP.DOC_SEQ, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_UNIT FROM PRODUCTION_PLAN PP JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID WHERE PP.PROD_PLAN_ID = #{prodPlanId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCTION_PLAN SET PROD_PLAN_QTY = #{prodPlanQty}, PROD_PLAN_DATE = TO_DATE(#{prodPlanDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), DUE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{dueDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), REMARK = #{remark}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PROD_PLAN_ID = #{prodPlanId}
